source: Author requested seven more everyday camp-life objects, October 15, 2026. Specific designs remain brainstorming proposals.

defaults.Acquisition: Proposed contemporary fabrication or trade; availability and manufacturing details remain open.
defaults.Crafting / processing: Candidate finished object using qualified T1 stock; no quantities, recipe, production time or yield authored.
defaults.Limitations: Dimensions, material grade, safe operating limits and compatibility remain design work. Food-heating concepts require a setting-compatible managed heat source; no free-water cooking, wooden parts or cloth assumed.
defaults.Classification basis: Author-requested everyday camp-life expansion; organization and intended use are proposals, not implemented actions.
defaults.Tier basis: Proposed T2 finished object using qualified T1 stock. A planning tier does not establish an executable recipe, material quantities, performance or availability.

items.name: Divided meal-warming pot
items.purpose: Two removable ceramic meal cups sit in a shared metal cradle, keeping separate Phagia preparations apart while warming above a compatible managed heat source. Distinct from the catalog's single-chamber cooking pot; no water bath or ordinary fire assumed.
items.icon: An oval metal cradle holding two round ceramic inserts, one lid tipped aside.

items.name: Folding pot-lid rest
items.purpose: A low folding metal stand holds a removed cooking lid upright, keeping its inner surface away from ground grit. Fit and hot-contact stability need design.
items.icon: A small crossed metal stand with two raised hooks supporting a round lid edge.

items.name: Cam-lever tie-down buckle
items.purpose: A broad metal cam lever grips a compatible existing camp binding to secure bundled gear or a shelter edge. It supplies a fastener, not extra line; holding force and binding compatibility remain undefined.
items.icon: A flattened oval buckle with a lifted ribbed lever and two open binding slots.

items.name: Three-hole guyline tensioner
items.purpose: A small perforated metal plate adjusts the working length of a compatible existing shelter line. Complements the existing guyline bundle and ground stakes; it is neither a new line supply nor a ground anchor.
items.icon: A rounded triangular metal plate with three differently spaced holes and worn edges.

items.name: Split-ring hanging hook
items.purpose: A split metal ring and short hanging hook suspend a compatible utensil or small camp object from an existing rail or eye. This is domestic mounting hardware, separate from the grappling hook; it has no climbing rating.
items.icon: A heavy open ring joined to a compact downward hook with a flattened stop.

items.name: Hinged camp utensil case
items.purpose: A narrow metal case with internal dividers keeps eating tools together and separates their working ends from loose cargo grit. Closure details remain open; the case is not an airtight or sterile container.
items.icon: A long shallow metal case opened to reveal three narrow utensil channels.

items.name: Folding grit pan
items.purpose: A shallow metal pan collects grit swept from camp surfaces with the existing dust brush. Its short hinged handle folds flat for packing; the pan is dedicated to cleaning rather than food service.
items.icon: A broad shallow scoop with a straight lip and a short handle folded across its back.
